m: लब्धा f. N. of a partic. heroine, L.
a woman whose husband or lover is faithless, W.
लब्धान्तर mfn. one who has found an opportunity (-त्व n.), Śak.
one who has got access or admission, Ragh.
लब्धान्तर—त्व n.
लब्धानुज्ञ mfn. one who has obtained leave of absence, L.
लब्धास्पद mfn. one who has gained a footing or secured a position, Mālav.
लब्धातिशय mfn. one who has obtained the possession of supernatural power, Sāṃkhyas.
लब्धावकाश (Śak.; Kathās.) or लब्धा˚वसर (KauṣUp.; HPariś.), one who has found an opportunity or gained scope, one who has obtained leisure.

m: लब्ध mfn. taken, seized, caught, met with, found &c.
got at, arrived (as a moment), Kathās.
obtained (as a quotient in division), Col. (cf. लब्धि)
a: लब्ध — p. p. [लभ्-कर्मणि क्त] 1 Got, obtained, acquired. --2 Taken, received. --3 Perceived, apprehended. --4 Obtained (as by division &c.); see लभ्. --ब्धा A woman whose husband or lover is faithless (perhaps for विप्रलब्धा). --ब्धं That which is secured or got; लब्धं रक्षेदवक्षयात् H. 2. 8; R. 19. 3. --Comp. --अंतरं a. {1} one who has found an opportunity. {2} one who has got access or admission; R. 16. 7. --अवकाश, --अवसर a. {1} one who has found an opportunity. {2} (anything) that has gained a scope (for work); लब्धावकाशा मे प्रार्थना Ś. 1. {3} one who has obtained leisure, being at leisure; so लब्धलक्षण. --आस्पद a. one who has gained a footing or secured a position; M. 1. 17. --उदय a. {1} born, produced, sprung; लब्धोदया चांद्रमसीव लेखा Ku. 1. 25. {2} one who has got prosperity or elevation; स त्वत्तो लब्धोदयः ‘he owes his rise or elevation to you’. --काम a. one who has got his desired object. --कीर्ति a. become widely known, famous, celebrated. --चेतस्, --संज्ञ a. one who has come to his senses, restored to consciousness. --जन्मन् a. born, produced. --नामन्, --शब्द a. renowned, celebrated. --नाशः the of loss what has been acquired; लब्धनाशो यथा मृत्युः. --प्रशमनं {1} securing or keeping safe what has been acquired. {2} bestowing on a worthy recipient; Kull. on Ms. 7. 56. --लक्ष, --क्ष्य a. {1} one who has hit the mark. {2} skilled in the use of missiles. --वर्ण a. {1} learned. wise; चित्रं त्वदीये विषये समंतात् सर्वेऽपि लोकाः किल लब्धवर्णाः Rāj. P. {2} famous, renowned, celebrated; Mk. 4. 26. ˚भाज् a. respecting the learned; कृच्छ्रलब्धमपि लब्धवर्णभाक् तं दिदेश मुनये सलक्ष्मणं R. 11. 2. --विद्य a. learned, educated, wise. --सिद्धि a. one who has attained perfection or his desired object.

k.v: स्रस्तं ध्वस्तं भ्रष्टं स्कन्नं पन्नं च्युतं गलितम्. लब्धं प्राप्तं विन्नं भावितमासादितं च भूतं च॥

m: लब्ध—धन mfn. one who has acquired wealth, wealthy, W.
लब्ध—शब्द mfn. = -नामन् (q.v.), R.
लब्ध—चेतस् mfn. one who has recovered his right mind, restored to sense, recovered, W.
लब्ध—दत्त m. ‘restoring what has been received’, N. of a man, Kathās.
लब्ध—जन्मन् mfn. one who has obtained birth, born, ib.
लब्ध—काम mfn. one who has gained his wishes, MW.
लब्ध—कीर्ति mfn. one who has won fame or glory, ib.
लब्धक mf(इका)n. = लब्ध, obtained, got (see दुःख-लब्धिका).
लब्ध—लाभ mf(आ)n. one who has gained a profit or advantage, one who has attained his aim, satisfied, Kāraṇḍ.
one who has gained possession of (comp.), ib.
happily obtained or reached, ib.
लब्ध—लक्ष mfn. one who has hit the mark, one who has obtained the prize, proved, tried, tested in (loc.), Mn.; MBh.; Hariv.; Kathās.
skilled in the use of missiles, MW.
लब्ध—लक्ष m. N. of a man, MBh.
लब्ध—लक्षण mfn. one who his gained an opportunity for (doing anything), Daś.
लब्ध—लक्ष्य mfn. = -लक्ष above, R.; Kām.
लब्ध—नाश m. the loss of what has been acquired, MBh.
लब्ध—नामन् mfn. one who has gained a name, well spoken of, famous, celebrated, Kām.; Ratnāv. (‘for’ loc.; in Prākṛt).
लब्ध—निद्रा-सुख mfn. enjoying the pleasure of sleep, Ml.
लब्ध—पर-भाग mfn. one who has gained preeminence over (abl.), ib.
लब्ध—प्रणाश m. id., N. of the 4th book of the Pañca-tantra.
लब्ध—प्रशमन n. the securing of what has been acquired, keeping acquisitions in safety, Mn.; MBh.; Hariv.
(accord. to Kull. ‘bestowing acquisitions on a proper recipient’)
लब्ध—प्रशमन—स्वस्थ mfn. at ease by (reason of) the securing or secure possession of acquisitions, Ragh.
लब्ध—प्रसर mf(आ)n. that which has obtained free scope, moving at liberty, unimpeded, Mudr.; Ratnāv. (in Prākṛt).
लब्ध—प्रतिष्ठ mfn. one who has acquired fame or renown, Kum.
लब्ध—प्रत्यय mfn. one who has won confidence, one who has firm belief in (-ता f.), Ratnāv. (in Prākṛt).
लब्ध—प्रत्यय—ता f.
लब्ध—संहार mfn. brought together, b˚ about, Divyāv.
लब्ध—संज्ञ mfn. one who has recovered his senses, restored to consciousness, MBh.; R.
लब्ध—सम्भार mfn. = -संहार above, Divyāv.
लब्ध—सिद्धि mfn. one who has attained perfection, W.
लब्ध—तीर्थ mfn. one who has gained an opportunity, BhP.

m: लब्ध—वर्ण mfn. one who has gained a knowledge of letters, lettered, learned in (comp.), Ragh.; Pārśvan.
famous, renowned, Mṛcch.

k.v: धीमान्सूरिः कृती कृष्टिर्लब्धवर्णो विचक्षणः। दूरदर्शी दीर्घदर्शी श्रोत्रियच्छान्दसौ समौ॥ मीमांसको जैमिनीये वेदान्ती ब्रह्मवादिनि। वैशेषिके स्यादौलूक्यः सौगतः शून्यवादिनि। नैयायिकस्त्वक्षपादः स्यात्स्याद्वादिक आर्हकः। चार्वाकलौकायतिकौ सत्कार्ये सांख्यकापिलौ।

m: लब्ध—वर्ण—भाज् mfn. honouring the learned, Ragh.
लब्ध—वर mfn. one who has obtained a boon or favour, MBh.
लब्ध—वर m. N. of a dancing master, Kathās.
लब्ध—वत् mfn. one who has obtained or gained or received, MBh.
लब्ध—विद्य mfn. one who has acquired knowledge or wisdom, learned, educated, W.
लब्धव्य mfn. to be obtained or received, obtainable &c., MBh.; Śaṃk.
लब्धृ mfn. one who obtains or receives, a receiver, gainer, recipient, KaṭhUp.; MārkP.
लब्धि f. obtaining, gaining, acquisition, Yājñ.; Kathās.; Pur.
gain, profit, VarBṛS.
in (arithm.) the quotient, Col.
a: लब्धिः — f. [लभ्-क्तिन्] 1 Acquisition, gaining, acquirement. --2 Profit, gain. --3 (In arith.) The quotient.

m: लब्धोदय mfn. one who has received birth or origin, Kum.
one who has attained prosperity, Rājat.
